name: Argument jitter: wording and case of a categorical value in a free string field

messages.content: You are a ticket routing assistant. Route every incoming ticket with the route_ticket tool. Never answer in prose without calling the tool. After the tool result comes back, reply with exactly the single lowercase word: routed
Ticket T-4407 arrived by email: the customer says they were charged twice for the same monthly subscription.

function.name: route_ticket
function.description: Send a support ticket to the queue that handles it.

ticket_id.description: The ticket identifier exactly as the user gave it, e.g. T-4407.

queue.description: The destination queue for this ticket, for example billing, shipping, or technical.
